definition-dropped.answer: Spurious for this rule: 'method' in the RECORD DELIMITER clause means the technique for determining a variable-length record's length (§2002:12.3.4.11.3 GR4 "the method used for determining the length of a variable-length record"), not the object-oriented term of §2002:4; the rule's scope is unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Not dependent: method invocation (§2002:9.3.5) has nothing to do with the RECORD DELIMITER length-determination method; the scope and evidence stand.
